articles.title: Ellis Kessler, 79, Neighborhood Baker
articles.deck: Friends remember Ellis Kessler for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Ellis Kessler died in July at home on Pearl Avenue, at the age of 79.

Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Ellis Kessler spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Stonebridge Trail Crew in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Saturday Cleanup Day
body: To the editor: I have lived on Laurel Street for 37 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
Please keep the Saturday cleanup day in the budget. Many of us on Laurel Street use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting.
Celia Whitcomb, Marsh Landing
